title: Come up, Kinch! Come up, you fearful jesuit!
html_source: Perhaps derived from Romeo and Juliet (III, iii, 1). “Romeo, come forth, come forth, thou fearful man.” Also, alludes to kinchin or child and the sound of a cutting knife.

anchor.text: Come up, Kinch! Come up, you fearful jesuit!
